carapace: A little more than twice as long as high, with mid-dorsal groove bifurcating posteriorly; surface covered with numerous small spines.
pseudorostrum: Two-ninths of total carapace length, prominent and sharply pointed; lower part serrated.
antenna_1: First two segments studded with blunt spines; first segment nearly twice as long as second and more than twice as long as third.
maxilliped_2: Ischiobasis fairly long; terminal seta long and slender; carpus with five spines; propodus with tooth; dactyl with three spines.
maxilliped_3: Basis long, serrated; merus and carpus serrated.
pereopod_2: Basis about half as long as rest; dactyl slender, tapered, with three spines.
uropod: Peduncle serrated, more than twice as long as endopod; endopod longer than exopod, with spines.
